verses.text: Chase love, and earnestly seek spiritual gifts—especially the gift of speaking God’s message.
If you speak in another language, you’re speaking to God, not people. Nobody understands; by the Spirit you’re speaking mysteries.
But when you speak God’s message, you’re speaking to people to build them up, encourage them, and comfort them.
The person speaking in another language builds themselves up; the one speaking God’s message builds up the church.

I wish all of you could speak in other languages, but I’d rather you speak God’s message. The one who prophesies is more useful to the church—unless the other speaker interprets, so the church can be built up too.
Family, if I came to you speaking other languages, what good would that do unless I brought you a revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?
Even lifeless instruments—like a flute or harp—need distinct notes. Otherwise, how would you know what tune they’re playing?
If a trumpet gives an unclear signal, who’s going to get ready for battle?
It’s the same with you: if your words aren’t clear, how will anyone know what you’re saying? You’ll just be talking into the air.
There are plenty of languages in the world, and not one of them is meaningless.
But if I don’t know what someone’s language means, we’ll sound like foreigners to each other.
Since you’re eager for spiritual gifts, aim to excel at the gifts that build up the church.
So if you speak in another language, pray for the ability to interpret it too.
If I pray in another language, my spirit is praying, but my mind isn’t producing anything useful.
So what should I do? I’ll pray with my spirit, and I’ll pray with my mind too. I’ll sing with my spirit, and I’ll sing with my mind too.
Otherwise, if you praise God in the Spirit, how can someone who doesn’t understand say “Amen” to your thanks? They have no idea what you’re saying.
You may be giving thanks beautifully, but the other person isn’t being built up.
I thank God I speak in other languages more than all of you.
But in church I’d rather say five words people understand and teach them than ten thousand words in a language nobody understands.
Family, don’t be children in how you think. Be babies when it comes to evil, but grow up in your thinking.
Scripture says, “I’ll speak to this people through foreign tongues and unfamiliar lips, but even then they won’t listen to me, says the Lord.”
So other languages are a sign for unbelievers, while prophecy is for believers.
If the whole church gathers and everyone speaks in other languages, and outsiders or people who don’t understand walk in, won’t they say you’re out of your minds?
But if everyone speaks God’s message and an outsider or someone who doesn’t understand comes in, they’ll be corrected and called to account by what everyone says.
The secrets of their heart will be exposed. They’ll bow down and worship God, saying, “God is truly among you!”
So what’s the move, family? When you gather, one has a song, another a teaching, a revelation, a language, or an interpretation. Let everything build people up.
If someone speaks in another language, let two speak—or at most three—and take turns. Someone must interpret.
If there’s no interpreter, the speaker should stay quiet in the church and speak to themselves and to God.
Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others weigh what’s said.
If someone sitting nearby receives a revelation, the first speaker should stop.
That way all of you can speak God’s message one by one, so everyone can learn and be encouraged.
The prophets’ spirits are under the prophets’ control.
God isn’t about chaos; he’s about peace—as in all the churches of God’s people.
Wives should be quiet in the church gatherings. They aren’t permitted to speak but should be in submission, as the Law also says.
If they want to learn something, let them ask their own husbands at home. It’s shameful for a wife to speak in the church gathering.
What? Did God’s word start with you? Are you the only ones it ever reached?
If anyone thinks they’re a prophet or Spirit-led, they should recognize that what I’m writing is the Lord’s command.
If someone refuses to recognize this, let them remain in their ignorance.
So, family, earnestly desire to speak God’s message, and don’t forbid speaking in other languages.
Just make sure everything is done properly and in good order.
